title: 8 Rumba Basic Steps every Beginner should Learn || Rumba Dance Beginner Steps Tutorial

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher provides clear, step-by-step instructions for each dance move. She demonstrates the steps from the back to make it easier for the viewer to follow along.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces herself and the topic of the video.
The teacher breaks down the basic step of Rumba.
The teacher breaks down the New York step.
The teacher breaks down the Spot Turn.
The teacher breaks down the Hand to Hand step.
The teacher breaks down the Basic in Place step.
The teacher breaks down the Open Basic step.
The teacher breaks down the Alternative Basic step.
The teacher breaks down the Progressive Walks Forward & Back.
The teacher performs a short routine incorporating the steps taught.

steps_taught.name: Basic Step
steps_taught.description: Consists of a step to the side, a forward break, and a back break.

steps_taught.name: New York
steps_taught.description: Consists of a side step and a forward break, connected by a 90-degree change of direction.

steps_taught.name: Spot Turn
steps_taught.description: A turn that can be danced solo or used by the follower to dance an underarm turn.

steps_taught.name: Hand to Hand
steps_taught.description: The opposite of a New York, where you cross over into a back break on count 2.

steps_taught.name: Basic in Place
steps_taught.description: Simply stepping together to the Rumba rhythm.

steps_taught.name: Open Basic
steps_taught.description: Contains a forward step and a back step, connected by a forward break and a back break.

steps_taught.name: Alternative Basic
steps_taught.description: Similar to the basic step, but you step together on counts 2 and 3.

steps_taught.name: Progressive Walks Forward & Back
steps_taught.description: Can be linked and danced continuously.

what_works: The teacher breaks down each step clearly.
The teacher demonstrates the steps from the back, making it easy to follow.

quotes.text: The basic step of Rumba consists of three parts.
The New York in Rumba consists of two parts.
The spot turn can be danced solo for both partners.
Hand to hand is in a way the opposite of a New York.
The basic in place is simply stepping together to the Rumba rhythm.
An open basic contains a forward step on 4-1 and a back step on 4-1.
